title: Joash Hides and Athaliah Is Killed

questions.question: Who destroyed the royal family of Judah after Ahaziah died?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:1 (ESV): "Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal family."

questions.question: Who hid Joash from Athaliah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:2 (ESV): "But Jehosheba... took Joash... and stole him away... and she put him and his nurse in a bedroom."

questions.question: How long was Joash hidden in the house of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:3 (ESV): "And he remained with her six years in the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who organized the overthrow of Athaliah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:4 (ESV): "But in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and summoned the captains..."

questions.question: What happened to Athaliah?
options: She was put to death with the sword
questions.correctAnswer: She was put to death with the sword
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:16, 20 (ESV): "...and there she was put to death... they had slain Athaliah with the sword..."

questions.question: How old was Joash when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:21 (ESV): "Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign."

questions.question: What did the people cry out when Joash was crowned?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:12 (ESV): "...and they clapped their hands and said, 'Long live the king!'"

questions.question: What did Athaliah cry out when she saw the king standing by the pillar?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:14 (ESV): "...Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried out, 'Treason! Treason!'"

questions.question: Where was Athaliah killed?
options: At the horses' entrance to the king's house
questions.correctAnswer: At the horses' entrance to the king's house
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:16 (ESV): "So they laid hands on her; and she went through the horses' entrance to the king's house, and there she was put to death."

questions.question: What covenant did Jehoiada make?
options: Between the LORD and the king and people, that they should be the LORD's people
questions.correctAnswer: Between the LORD and the king and people, that they should be the LORD's people
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:17 (ESV): "And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and people, that they should be the LORD's people..."

questions.question: What priest of Baal was killed?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:18 (ESV): "...and they killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars."

questions.question: Who was Jehosheba related to?
options: Daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah
questions.correctAnswer: Daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:2 (ESV): "But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah..."

questions.question: What did the guards communicate to each other to protect the king?
options: Each had his weapons in his hand and surrounded the king
questions.correctAnswer: Each had his weapons in his hand and surrounded the king
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:8 (ESV): "And you shall surround the king, each with his weapons in his hand..."

questions.question: Why did Jehoiada command that Athaliah not be slain in the house of the Lord?
options: Lest the house of the LORD be defiled
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the house of the LORD be defiled
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:15 (ESV): "...For the priest said, 'Do not let her be put to death in the house of the LORD.'"

questions.question: What objects did Jehoiada give the captains?
options: The spears and shields that had been King David's
questions.correctAnswer: The spears and shields that had been King David's
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 11:10 (ESV): "And the priest gave to the captains of hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David's..."

key_verse_text: Then he brought out the king's son and put the crown on him and gave him the testimony. And they proclaimed him king and anointed him, and they clapped their hands and said, “Long live the king!” (ESV)
